tools.name: enchant_list_tickets
tools.description: List and filter tickets (newest first by default). Enchant REST: GET /tickets. Use user_ids ["null"] for unassigned tickets. Each result has a short summary; use enchant_get_ticket for messages.

tools.name: enchant_get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by id. Embed related data with `embed`: messages (the conversation: replies and notes), customer, user, inbox, labels. Each embedded type costs 1 extra rate-limit credit. Enchant REST: GET /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_list_users
tools.description: List the help desk users (agents): id, name, email. Use the ids to assign tickets and to author replies and notes. Enchant REST: GET /users.

tools.name: enchant_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, or find one by contact: set contact_type and contact_value (for example email + an address). Enchant REST: GET /customers.

tools.name: enchant_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with the contacts (emails, phones, Twitter names). Enchant REST: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_get_attachment
tools.description: Get the metadata of an attachment (name, size, MIME type) by id; attachment ids appear in ticket messages. Enchant REST: GET /attachments/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_create_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: create an email ticket. Give customer_id, or a customer (matched by contact email, created if new). Optionally add the customer's first message with body (needs the customer's email). Enchant REST: POST /tickets.

tools.name: enchant_update_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: change a ticket: state (open, hold, closed), assignee, inbox, subject, spam or trash (not both true). label_ids REPLACES all labels (empty array clears them); use enchant_add_ticket_labels to keep existing ones. Enchant REST: PATCH /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_add_ticket_labels
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more labels to a ticket without changing its other labels. Enchant REST: PUT /tickets/{id}/labels/{label_ids}.

tools.name: enchant_remove_ticket_labels
tools.description: WRITE: remove one or more labels from a ticket; its other labels stay. Enchant REST: DELETE /tickets/{id}/labels/{label_ids}.

tools.name: enchant_reply_to_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: send an outbound reply on a ticket. This SENDS A REAL EMAIL to the customer address in `to`. Use enchant_add_note for an internal note. Enchant REST: POST /tickets/{id}/messages (type reply, direction out).

tools.name: enchant_add_note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a ticket (not sent to the customer). Enchant REST: POST /tickets/{id}/messages (type note).

tools.name: enchant_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer with optional contacts (email, twitter, phone). Enchant REST: POST /customers.

tools.name: enchant_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: update a customer's name or summary. If `contacts` is given, it REPLACES the contact list; use enchant_add_customer_contact to add one. Enchant REST: PATCH /customers/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_add_customer_contact
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact (email, twitter or phone) to a customer. Enchant REST: POST /customers/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: enchant_delete_customer_contact
tools.description: WRITE, DELETES DATA: remove one contact from a customer. Enchant REST: DELETE /customers/{id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: enchant_list_tickets, enchant_get_ticket, enchant_list_users, enchant_list_customers, enchant_get_customer, enchant_get_attachment, enchant_update_ticket · Private data: enchant_list_customers, enchant_get_customer, enchant_create_ticket, enchant_create_customer, enchant_update_customer, enchant_add_customer_contact, enchant_delete_customer_contact · Public sink: enchant_list_users, enchant_list_customers, enchant_create_ticket, enchant_reply_to_ticket, enchant_add_note, enchant_create_customer, enchant_add_customer_contact · Destructive: enchant_remove_ticket_labels, enchant_delete_customer_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: enchant_list_tickets, enchant_get_ticket, enchant_list_users, enchant_list_customers, enchant_get_customer, enchant_get_attachment, enchant_update_ticket · Private data: enchant_list_customers, enchant_get_customer, enchant_create_ticket, enchant_create_customer, enchant_update_customer, enchant_add_customer_contact, enchant_delete_customer_contact · Public sink: enchant_list_users, enchant_list_customers, enchant_create_ticket, enchant_reply_to_ticket, enchant_add_note, enchant_create_customer, enchant_add_customer_contact · Destructive: enchant_remove_ticket_labels, enchant_delete_customer_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
